summary: Phase 1.5 (Resend notification channel + public tokenized same-order retry) review. Backend: 12/12 new pytest probes passed (/app/backend/tests/test_iteration9_phase15_probe.py) covering resend status/diagnostics masking, anonymous rejection of all 3 resend endpoints (incl. PUT /config), public retry 404/400 negatives, invalid-signature rejection with no linked_payment_id, order-mismatch rejection, and idempotent completion (duplicate:true, exactly 1 RECOVERY_PAYMENT_LINKED audit) using an ephemeral synthetic case/action that was deleted afterwards. Frontend: /pay/{invalid} shows pay-retry-error without crashing; /pay/{real token rct_b51b...4002ee7cf15} renders order_LAB74F98C, Rs 6,750.00 and an enabled 'Pay securely via Razorpay' button; /integrations (owner cookie) renders resend-section with CONNECTED badge, Disable + Send test email buttons and the Real Test Checkout section; no key-like ('ek_...') or key_secret/webhook_secret material in page source or in any of the 10 captured /api responses. Honored all constraints: never called PUT resend/config, /cases/{id}/execute, test-lab endpoints, checkout automation, or the full pytest suite; razorpay/resend config untouched (resend still enabled=true, last_test_ok=true).

minor.issue: Unauthenticated 500 Internal Server Error on malformed input: body 'notjson' (raw await request.json() raises JSONDecodeError) and wrong-typed fields ({"razorpay_payment_id":123,"razorpay_order_id":null,"razorpay_signature":[]} -> .strip() on int/list). Should be 400/422. Public endpoint, so any bot can generate 500s.

Recovery tokens have no expiry/TTL field even though user-facing copy says 'invalid or expired'; a token stays valid indefinitely (9 live tokens found in recovery_actions). Consider expires_at + single-use semantics after linking.

issues: Footer reassurance line uses text-[11px] text-slate-400 on white (contrast ~2.6:1, below WCAG AA for small text) - use slate-500/600
No visible merchant/order context beyond order id; acceptable for MVP

action_items: Add a Pydantic request model (or try/except around request.json()) to POST /api/recovery/pay/{token}/complete so malformed/wrong-typed bodies return 400/422 instead of 500.
Optional hardening: add expires_at (and/or single-use invalidation) to recovery_token, plus basic rate limiting on the public /api/recovery/pay/* endpoints.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_recovery.py complete_retry parses the body with raw await request.json() and calls .strip() on untyped values - the only correctness gap found in Phase 1.5; everything else (HMAC compare_digest signature check, idempotency guard before audit write, _id excluded from all finds, no secret in responses) is correct.
Signature verification happens before any mutation and the duplicate guard returns before write_audit, so attribution cannot be double-counted - verified empirically.

success_rate.backend: 12/12 probes passed (100%); 2 additional negative-input probes revealed 500s (see minor issues)

Real unlinked recovery token for read-only probes: rct_b51b5051253e49aabc781da3f35fe4002ee7cf15 (case_7f498c5df267 / order_LAB74F98C, Rs 6750, status EVALUATED). To test valid completion without touching live data, create your own case+action and forge the signature with HMAC-SHA256(key_secret, 'order|payment') reading key_secret from integrations.razorpay (see test_iteration9_phase15_probe.py TestIdempotentCompletion). Do NOT run the full pytest suite (test_notifications.py sends genuine emails) and do not use the razorpay_integration_guard fixture during a live demo.
rca_of_the_issue: 500 on /api/recovery/pay/{token}/complete: the handler reads the JSON body manually (body = await request.json()) with no schema, so (a) invalid JSON raises json.JSONDecodeError inside the handler and (b) non-string field values raise AttributeError on .strip(); both escape as unhandled exceptions -> 500. Reproduce: curl -X POST <base>/api/recovery/pay/<real-token>/complete -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data 'notjson'. Fix: declare a Pydantic BaseModel body with three required str fields.
